dt-example.title: CardView
dt-example.info:
The [CardView extension](https://datatables.net/manual/extensions/cardview) for DataTables provides the ability to change between a card display of the source data, or the regular table display. The `-button cardView` and `-button tableView` buttons provide the ability for the end user to toggle between the two modes manually and this can be included in saved states, as shown in this example.
The `cardView` option of `-init stateRestore.include` option is set to `null` in this example, so you can selectively include, or exclude, the CardView mode in the state.
